transport: JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP (the canonical A2A wire protocol)

reference_agent.runtime: Node.js built-in http module (no Express dependency)
serves: POST / — JSON-RPC handler for SendMessage, GetTask, CancelTask
reference_agent.computes: SHA-256 hash of input text (deterministic, verifiable)

methods.SendMessage: params: SendMessageRequest; result: { task: Task } or { message: Message }

wire_format.part_wire_format: Oneof fields are top-level keys: { text: 'value', filename: '', mediaType: 'text/plain' } (NOT nested under content)
wire_format.task_state_enum: TASK_STATE_UNSPECIFIED=0, SUBMITTED=1, WORKING=2, COMPLETED=3, FAILED=4, CANCELED=5, INPUT_REQUIRED=6, REJECTED=7, AUTH_REQUIRED=8
